messages:
DeployBot: [deploy] Canary rollout started for service-infer v2.3.0 (deploy id 8421) -> prod-us-west. Rolling 5% -> 50% over 15m. Release notes: https://releases.redwood/infer/8421.

sam: saw a bump in 5xxs starting ~14:12 UTC, current error rate ~3.2% (baseline ~0.2%). Noticed increased tail latency too.

maria: kube events show multiple OOMKilled on infer-0 (3x in last 7m). Also seeing liveness probe flaps.

priya: quick check on automated rollback config — we have autorevert on >10% 5xx OR 2 OOMs in 10m, right?

luis: correct, that's the rule. Looks like kube OOM metric reported but autorevert didn't trigger because probe types differed (readiness vs liveness). We should do manual rollback.

sam: +1 to manual rollback. I'll execute rollback to v2.2.9 and pin until we investigate. Command I'm going to run:```/deploy rollback service-infer --deploy-id 8421 --to-version v2.2.9``` I will also ping @pd-bot and @on-call.

DeployBot: Manual rollback requested for deploy id 8421. Rollback job queued (job 8421-rollback). Estimated time 3m. Logs: https://ci.redwood/jobs/8421-rollback

pd-bot: Paging on-call: sam initiated manual rollback for service-infer (prod-us-west).

sam: running rollback now. Kicking off kubectl rollout undo on the infer deployment, then waiting for new pods.

maria: seeing pods terminate, new pods coming up with v2.2.9 image. Health checks starting.

luis: I pushed a temporary pin in router-config: service-infer.pinned_versions = ["v2.2.9"] to prevent accidental re-rollout during investigation. Link: https://config.redwood/router/service-infer

sam: rollback completed — all pods at v2.2.9, readiness healthy. Error rate down to 0.3%, latency returned to baseline. :thumbsup:

priya: great. We'll update release notes with rollback summary and open a postmortem. Action items: (1) investigate why autorevert didn't catch the probe pattern, (2) add a probe mapping rule so OOM+readiness flaps trigger rollback, (3) adjust canary thresholds for model upgrades.

maria: created incident ticket INC-2026-0923 and assigned to eng-ml + eng-runtime.

luis: I removed the temporary router pin after confirmation from priya to keep system on v2.2.9 until next controlled canary. Config change logged.

sam: closing out here — follow-ups in #postmortems and INC-2026-0923. Thanks everyone.
